body:
calcbox.add(2, 3) prints `add(2, 3) = 6` instead of `add(2, 3) = 5`.

Repro: install calcbox==1.2.0 and print add(2, 3) — the result is always one too high.
Expected: add(2, 3) = 5.
Environment: calcbox 1.2.0, stock python3, no dependencies.
comments: Same here: add(0, 0) gives 1. Every sum is off by one.
sub() looks fine; only add() drifts.
title: add() returns a sum that is off by one
